_README: Record of what the sync-subject skill has published from Notion, and when.
Written by .claude/skills/sync-subject. Not a build artefact and nothing at serve time reads it —
it is a published-state record, the same kind of thing next-prompt.md is.
HOW CHANGE IS DETECTED (see also SKILL.md Phase 0):
A Notes database row exposes an 'Edited Time' property. A CHILD page inside a note does not —
fetching one returns only {"title": ...}. The only per-child timestamp available is the
'as of <ISO>' stamp in the notion-fetch response envelope, recorded here as observedAt.
observedAt was verified on 2026-08-05 to be a CONTENT timestamp, not a fetch timestamp:
fetching the same page twice minutes apart returned an identical value (07:36:00.112Z), and
sibling pages returned different values. It is not documented by Notion, so it is used as a
strong hint, never as proof.
A week is treated as CHANGED when ANY of these moved: the note's Edited Time, the note's or a
topic's observedAt, or the shape of the child tree (an added, removed or renamed sub-page).
That can over-trigger, which costs one harvest. To guard against UNDER-triggering — the case
where a grandchild is edited and no recorded timestamp moves — each topic carries a
contentHash of its harvested Markdown. The cheap pass decides whether to harvest; the hash
decides whether to rebuild. If Aryan says he edited a deep sub-page, run a deep pass:
re-harvest every topic and compare hashes.
contentHash is null for every DMBA6008 topic because the 2026-08-05 build predates this file
and its harvest lived in a session scratchpad that did not survive. The next run of each of
those topics fills it in; until then they fall back to timestamp-only detection.
DMBA6005 was built on 2026-08-06 and every published topic carries a real hash.
contentHash is sha256 of the harvested Markdown, first 12 hex chars, computed AFTER stripping
any <!-- ... --> annotations the skill itself adds — so a re-harvest of unchanged prose hashes
identically even if the annotations are reworded. Empty and unpublished topics carry null.
